state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad`, `Core\Ldap\Change` and `Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType` owe nothing.

**7 of the 24 `Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` members owe nothing**: `bits`, `mustChangePassword`, `with`, `disabled`, `passwordNeverExpires`, `lockedOut` and `passwordExpired`. The other 17 flag readers still owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each; every one has its tests proof. `Core\Ldap\Entry::isDeleted` owes the same. `Core\Ldap\Connection` (`setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare`), `Core\Ldap\Entries` (`references`, `total`) and `Core\Ldap\Changes::cookie` owe everything, and `total` and `cookie` also owe a Rust test with a `covers:` marker.

**The proof trees are granted `[ldap.corp]` by directory** in the root `nvs.toml`, under each of the three trees, for `Ldap-Entry`, `Ldap-Ad-GroupType` and `Ldap-Ad-AccountFlags`. An `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program in the repository with `E0605`. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`: it takes **one** `--id`, and a second is ignored. `--bless` takes files, never a directory. `--record-perf` fails its calibration while `bun nv verify` runs, and verify's build fails on a locked `nvs.exe` while a proof run is going, so run the two one after the other. `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Ad-AccountFlags/disabled/` is the model for an account flag reader, and `.../with/` for setting a flag on a copy.

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded** by `20-novis-seed` in `tests/db/compose.yaml` (its comment lists every user, group and password). `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `CN=Reader,OU=Company,DC=example,DC=test`. People are `CN=Anna Berg`, `CN=Ben Kohl`, `CN=Carla Diaz` and `CN=Dora Lind` under `OU=Company`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** RIDs follow the seed order (`Reader` 1103, `Employees` 1104, `Managers` 1105, `Newsletter` 1106, `anna.berg` 1107, `ben.kohl` 1108, `dora.lind` 1110), `Administrator` is 500. `userAccountControl` is 512 for `anna.berg` and `carla.diaz`, 514 for `dora.lind` and 66048 for `ben.kohl` and `Reader`. `carla.diaz` has `pwdLastSet` 0, so `mustChangePassword()` and `passwordExpired()` are both `true` for her and `false` for everyone else. Nobody is locked out. A search for `objectClass=user` under `OU=Company` finds the five users, `Reader` among them. `groupType` is -2147483646 for `Employees` and `Managers` (global security) and 2 for `Newsletter` (global distribution). Samba's own groups are readable too: `CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin` and `CN=Users,CN=Builtin` are -2147483643, `CN=Cert Publishers,CN=Users` is -2147483644, and `CN=Enterprise Admins,CN=Users` and `CN=Schema Admins,CN=Users` are -2147483640. The domain has `maxPwdAge` 6w, `minPwdLength` 7 and `pwdHistoryLength` 24. GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot.

**`Reader` cannot read any attribute of a deleted object**, so `isDeleted()` is `false` on everything it can find, and the seed deletes nothing.

**This handoff was written by hand**: `bun nv session --wrap` refused because another agent had uncommitted edits under `docs/rules/testing/` and `website/` (the `nvs test` directory work), which its tree-wide gates read as this session's.

Each member owes `about.md`, three examples with `.out` from `--bless`, one attack and one bench, then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <id> <id> ...`, one argument per id, after verify has finished. **The next five `AccountFlags` readers owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `workstationTrustAccount`, `serverTrustAccount`, `mnsLogonAccount`, `smartcardRequired` and `trustedForDelegation`, at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/value.rs:420`.

backlog: The last five `AccountFlags` readers (`notDelegated` to `partialSecretsAccount`), at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/value.rs:444` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
`Core\Ldap\Entry::isDeleted`'s proofs: `Reader` cannot see a deleted object, so an example needs a seeded deletion and a bind that may read `CN=Deleted Objects` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`).
`Core\Ldap\Connection`'s `setPassword`, `changePassword` and `compare`, which need a block that binds as a user allowed to write (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
`Core\Ldap\Entries::total` and `Core\Ldap\Changes::cookie` owe a Rust test with a `covers:` marker, then the rest of their proofs.
A CA a program supplies (Stage 4) and the schema wired into the readers (Stage 6), in `docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`.
